messages:
sam-infra: heads-up, we started seeing a surge of 504s from the hosted inference API ~08:10 UTC after rollout shard swap. dashboards show error-rate jumping to ~6% for route /v1/generate :grimacing:
anya-eng: seeing same. alerts triggered: gateway latency + downstream timeouts. stacktrace points to proxy -> routing layer, 100ms extra p99 then downstream idle timeouts.
maria-support: Customer tickets inbound: two enterprise tenants reporting repeated 504s and timeouts; they hit batch endpoints. I can share request ids if helpful.
eve-sre: quick telemetry: canary rollout id=rl-2026-04-17-09 on cluster shard-b2. Route weight moved from shard-a -> shard-b2 at 08:05 UTC. heatmap shows traffic skewed; shard-b2 pods have higher 5xx and connection resets.
anya-eng: I ran basic repro, curl to /v1/generate with our test key returns 504 in ~12s. curl -v shows backend stream closed: 
```
> GET /v1/generate
> Authorization: Bearer sk-test
> Content-Type: application/json
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.example left intact
```
julian-eng: logs show authz header trimmed by proxy when route tag present. We changed header normalization in the new shard config to drop long headers to protect upstream. That might be stripping the internal routing metadata key x-rw-route-tag.
maria-support: the tickets include request IDs: req_3f7a, req_3f84 — both 504 around 08:12 UTC. Putting them in the incident ticket.
eve-sre: ops-bot, can you reduce traffic to shard-b2 to 5% and re-route to shard-a? We need to stop the customer impact ASAP. :pray:
ops-bot: acknowledged. Starting staged weight rollback to shard-a (target 95%) now. ETA 60s. :gear:
deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-04-17-09 override: traffic_weight shard-b2 -> 5% executed by ops-bot at 08:18 UTC.
sam-infra: good. keep watchers on p95/p99 and customer tickets. any quick mitigation patch?
anya-eng: patch idea: revert header normalization change (re-enable x-rw-route-tag passthrough) and restart proxy on shard-b2 only. I'll prepare a canary hotfix.
julian-eng: can confirm: config snippet that caused issue:
```
proxy.headers.normalize: true
proxy.headers.trim_length: 256
proxy.headers.drop_on_tag: true
```
revert to normalize=false for key x-rw-route-tag should stop route mismatches.
eve-sre: agree, but let's only roll to shard-b2 after traffic reduced. Maria, please update the customers that we're rolling back shard weight and hotfix will be staged.
maria-support: messaging sent to affected customers: "We're investigating increased timeouts on batch generation. We've reduced your traffic exposure and are rolling a fix; we'll follow up with timeline."
ops-bot: shard-b2 traffic reduced to 5% confirmed. Error rate dropped to 0.9% within 90s. p99 latency improving.
anya-eng: preparing hotfix PR now, will push to shard-b2 as a canary at 5% traffic, then ramp after 10m stable. Link to PR: https://git.internal/rw/proxy/commit/abcd1234
sam-infra: thanks. after hotfix, let's run synthetic load against shard-b2 replica with header set and confirm no 504s before ramp. Also capture kernel and TCP metrics.
eve-sre: agreed. I'll monitor netstat and conn resets. tagging incident channel for postmortem once stable. :white_check_mark:
julian-eng: follow-up: add unit test for header passthrough and add integration test that exercises x-rw-route-tag in the routing middleware.
maria-support: closing the immediate customer loop now. will reopen if they report recurrences.
sam-infra: archive notes: root cause likely header trimming policy interacting with new shard routing policy; mitigation: rollback weight + hotfix revert. Postmortem owners: anya-eng, eve-sre, julian-eng, maria-support.
ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated.
